name: Lead

health_effects.details: Neurotoxin affecting cognitive development in children. Causes cardiovascular and renal damage.

description_en: Found heavily in CRT monitors, lead-acid batteries, and older printed circuit boards. Highly toxic even at low exposure levels.

name: Mercury

health_effects.details: Potent neurotoxin. Vapors cause severe respiratory and neurological damage.

env_effects.soil: Bioaccumulates in the food chain as methylmercury.
env_effects.water: Highly toxic to fish and aquatic life.

description_en: Found in fluorescent lamps, LCD screen backlights, and old switches. Easily vaporizes during crude e-waste dismantling.

name: Cadmium

health_effects.details: Carcinogen. Causes severe kidney damage and bone demineralization (Itai-itai disease).

description_en: Historically used in Ni-Cd rechargeable batteries, older CRT monitors, and as a stabilizer in plastics.

name: Chromium VI

health_effects.details: Known human carcinogen if inhaled. Causes severe skin ulcers and respiratory issues.

env_effects.soil: Mobile in soil and can leach into groundwater.

description_en: Hexavalent chromium is used for corrosion protection in untreated galvanized steel plates and as a decorative or hard coating.

name: Polychlorinated Biphenyls (PCBs)

health_effects.details: Probable human carcinogen. Affects immune, reproductive, nervous, and endocrine systems.

description_en: Found in older transformers, capacitors, and fluorescent light ballasts. Banned globally but still present in legacy e-waste.

name: Dioxins

health_effects.details: Highly toxic. Carcinogenic, disrupts hormones, affects reproduction and immune system.

description_en: Unintentionally produced during the open burning of e-waste (especially PVC cables) to recover copper.

name: Furans

health_effects.details: Similar to dioxins; highly toxic, carcinogenic, hormone disruptors.

description_en: Polychlorinated dibenzofurans (PCDFs) are released alongside dioxins during the low-temperature combustion of plastics and e-waste.

name: Brominated Flame Retardants (BFRs)

health_effects.details: Endocrine disruptors, affecting thyroid function. Suspected neurodevelopmental toxicants.

description_en: Used extensively in plastic casings of electronics (TVs, computers) and printed circuit boards to prevent fires. Release toxic fumes when burned.

name: Black Carbon

health_effects.details: Deeply penetrates lungs, causing severe respiratory and cardiovascular diseases.

env_effects.atmosphere: Significant short-lived climate pollutant, absorbing heat in the atmosphere.

description_en: Soot produced from incomplete combustion during the open burning of e-waste tires and plastics at informal dumpsites.

name: Beryllium

health_effects.details: Carcinogen if inhaled. Causes berylliosis, an incurable inflammatory lung disease.

env_effects.soil: Can settle in soils from industrial dust.

description_en: Used in copper-beryllium alloys for connectors, springs, and relays in electronics due to high conductivity and strength.
